data.name: Poovarasan
data.gender_notes: Poovarasan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who rules over the river Poova. Poovarasan is a popular Hindu name inspired by Lord Shiva, the supreme god in Hinduism. The name is derived from the Tamil words 'poo' meaning river and 'varasan' meaning the ruler. Thus, Poovarasan is a name that signifies power, strength, and the ability to protect. The name Poovarasan carries the meaning “Lord of the River Poova” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil. Parents who choose Poovarasan usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the river poova and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine power of Lord Shiva, the god of destruction and transformation. The name Poovarasan is believed to invoke the blessings of Lord Shiva, who is also known as the ruler of the rivers.
data.etymology: Poovarasan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the River Poova.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Poovarasan total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Poovarasan holds significant cultural importance in Tamil Nadu, India. It reflects the connection between the people and the rivers, an essential aspect of Tamil culture. The Hindu deity Cauvery, also known as River Goddess, holds a special place in Tamil literature and folklore. The name Poovarasan pays homage to the power and significance of rivers in Tamil Nadu.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the god Shiva is often depicted as a ruler, a protector, and a destroyer. The name Poovarasan carries this spiritual significance as it symbolizes the power of Lord Shiva over the river Poova. It also illustrates the concept of the divine presence in nature and the connection between the divine and the human world. The name Poovarasan serves as a reminder of the ultimate power and control of God over all creation.
